quote.text: Clutter and confusion are failures of design, not attributes of information.
quote.author: Edward Tufte
quote.analysis: When an LP report is confusing or a portfolio dashboard feels cluttered, the instinct is to blame the data. Tufte corrects this: the data isn't the problem — the design is. Institutional data infrastructure must include the presentation layer as a first-class concern, not an afterthought tacked on by a junior analyst with a BI tool.
